_why: One place for the West Peek entity graph, so every page of every site can carry the
same Organization identity instead of it existing only on the three index pages.
Before this file, 3 of 14 built pages carried Organization schema; the other 11 were
anonymous to an answer engine even though they are part of a named, verifiable company.
sameAs is an identity claim, not a link list: it must point at pages that unambiguously
identify THAT entity. The three URLs below were checked live and all resolve to West Peek
Productions specifically, so they sit on the Productions node and nowhere else. The
community node keeps the umbrella profiles it already carried. Nothing here is guessed -
add a profile only after opening it.

https://joinwestpeek.com/#organization.name: West Peek
https://joinwestpeek.com/#organization.description: A community for founders and builders and the umbrella community behind West Peek Ventures and West Peek Productions.

https://westpeekproductions.com/#organiz.name: West Peek Productions
https://westpeekproductions.com/#organiz.description: A Community-as-a-Service and creative agency helping organizations build, engage, and grow communities through strategy, experiences, storytelling, brand, content, and audience growth.

https://westpeek.ventures/#organization.name: West Peek Ventures
https://westpeek.ventures/#organization.description: A pre-seed venture fund backing founders at the earliest stages.
